description: Use when an agent needs to screen a crypto wallet before paying or being paid. Returns an exact match of a Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, Solana or other address against the OFAC SDN list, with entry, program and list date. No match is not a clearance. Costs 0.008 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

address.description: a crypto address of any family: bitcoin, ethereum, tron, solana, xrp, litecoin and so on
